Parallel run metadata records five subagents, artifact copy success, process success, and stale aggregate quality showing 0 of 123 official samples.
Current status records the completed official RepoZero evaluation for the parallel artifact: 0 of 123 passed and solution_passed false.

Session index maps the parallel session id to the workspace session directory and /workspace work directory.
Numeric probe child tested rounding, negative zero, large values, special float inputs, and wrote raw numeric probe results under /tmp.

parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the need for byte-exact Money formatting, manual argparse behavior, ESM .mjs files in /output, zero dependencies, and locale environment handling.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It performed a quick locale discovery, launched four probe children for numeric, currency, CLI, and locale behavior, then assigned a single coder child to implement the full port.
parallel.implementation: The coder child wrote root-level currencies.mjs, decimal.mjs, locale.mjs, money.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test10.mjs, using generated currency data and custom decimal/string formatting.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Only the coder child owned final /output implementation files; the parent later listed and spot-checked those files before delivering the result.
parallel.verification: The coder reported a 487/487 comparison harness, 400/400 fuzz checks, byte checks, and a compliance sweep; the parent ran 13 additional sample and edge spot checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Before official evaluation, the parallel implementation knowingly left non-English real CLDR locales as English fallbacks and shortened unknown-currency traceback stderr; official evaluation still failed 0/123.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same ESM, .mjs, /output, manual argv parsing, no dependency, and byte-exact Money formatting requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept all probing, implementation, bug fixing, and verification in one serial trajectory without subagents or handoff boundaries.
serial.implementation: It generated /output/lib/currencies.mjs, pyfloat.mjs, decimal_format.mjs, locales.mjs, money.mjs, argparse.mjs, and /output/test10.mjs after sequential probing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial solution used a library subdirectory and a top-level entry point, with no cross-agent integration because the same actor wrote all artifacts.
serial.verification: It found and fixed a 5. numeric parser mismatch, passed a short smoke check with LANG set, compared argparse errors, and started a long full diff harness.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out or was manually interrupted while waiting for the full harness, had only 180 generated currencies from its candidate list, and also officially failed 0/123.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt constraints and additional locale dependence, including environment variable precedence and Money formatting details.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt constraints and independently probed both en_US and non-English locale-specific output behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel later narrowed non-English locale fidelity out of the coder brief, while serial attempted to carry more locale-specific behavior into implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed discovery into four probe children and assigned one coder child to own all implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor for probing, coding, bug fixing, and verification, so there were no child ownership boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained specialized probe coverage but introduced a parent-to-child scope boundary; serial avoided handoff risk but spent the whole budget sequentially.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probe handoffs were returned to the parent, but the implementation prompt explicitly told the coder to treat full non-English CLDR fidelity as out of scope.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no handoff interface; the same actor retained its locale probes while planning and implementing locale-specific formatting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete context difference is the parallel coder brief narrowing a known requirement, whereas serial maintained that context inside a single actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delivered six root-level modules and generated 181 currency entries, but its locale module deliberately used English fallback for known non-English locales.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered a lib-based implementation, generated 180 currency entries, and attempted broader locale rule coverage before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a more complete currency count and stronger internal harness, while serial invested more in locale-specific formatting but had an incomplete currency list and unfinished verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All four probe children returned and the coder child returned a completed implementation report that the parent inspected.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child returns; the serial full harness ran in the background and waiting for it was interrupted.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel completed its child-result lifecycle cleanly, while serial's local verification lifecycle remained unfinished at interruption.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Probe children wrote /tmp logs only and the single coder child wrote the final /output modules, with no observed competing final-file ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor wrote all final files itself under /output/lib plus /output/test10.mjs, so there was no concurrent shared-state conflict.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run shows a write collision; the main integration difference is root-level modules in parallel versus lib-subdirectory modules in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel accepted the solution after the coder's 487/487 harness, fuzzing, compliance sweep, and parent spot checks, despite known non-English locale fallback.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial fixed one parser mismatch and ran smoke and argparse checks, but its full comparison harness did not return before interruption.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had stronger completed local verification but accepted a visible known limitation; serial had broader intended verification but did not complete it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed within its agent budget, closed normally, and artifact validation copied six files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed its budget, status records timed_out true, and the trajectory ended while waiting on a background verification task.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel reached an orderly but flawed closure; serial closed under timeout/interruption pressure with verification unfinished.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: both the parallel and serial artifacts failed all 123 official samples. The trajectories nevertheless differ materially. Parallel completed its child-agent workflow and local verification but accepted a known locale-scope limitation; serial kept the work in one actor, attempted broader locale fidelity, and timed out while waiting for its full harness.
parallel_contributors: Parallel collected detailed probe results and completed a one-child implementation with internal harness and fuzz evidence.
Parallel knowingly scoped non-English real locale CLDR output to English fallback before final delivery.
The official evaluator result contradicts the local harness success, but the available pair evidence does not expose individual hidden testcase failures.
serial_contributors: Serial sequentially probed non-English locales and attempted implementation without child handoffs.
Serial generated only 180 currency entries from its candidate list and then spent remaining budget on verification.
Serial was interrupted while waiting for the full background comparison harness, leaving verification unfinished.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel wrote root-level modules, while serial wrote a lib subdirectory plus top-level entry.
Parallel generated 181 currency entries; serial generated 180 entries including older codes in its candidate list.
Parallel reported non-English locale fallback as accepted, while serial tried to model zh, de, fr, and ja outputs.
evaluator_effects: Both status records show completed official evaluation with 0 of 123 samples passed, but detailed testcase failure logs are not present in the allowed pair inputs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel-side process consequence, not a proven explanation for an outcome gap
